how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-the-barrens-03.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:6362:obj:0: Buy a wind rider to ⟦E1⟧ from the wind rider master Devrak, then bring the Bundle of Hides to Ahanu in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:6362:details:0: For a small fee, I will give you a wind rider to ⟦E1⟧. There's no faster way to the city!
rows.quest:6362:details:1: BIf that is acceptable, speak to me again when you are ready to go.
rows.quest:6362:details:2: BIf you're taking those hides to Ahanu, then I think he's at Hewa's Armory, at the base of the wind rider tower in ⟦E1⟧. And that's right where you'll land!
rows.quest:6362:completion:0: Ah, a new bundle of hides. I will get to work on these immediately!
rows.quest:6362:completion:1: BThank you, brother. You have done me a great service. Here are some coins to pay for your time and travel costs.
rows.quest:6363:obj:0: Bring Ahanu's Leather Goods to Tal in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:6363:details:0: I have prepared leather goods for Jahan to sell at the Crossroads. Will you bring them to him?
rows.quest:6363:details:1: BIf you have already been to the Crossroads and spoken to their wind rider master, then you can fly one of our ⟦E1⟧ wind riders back to him.
rows.quest:6363:details:2: BTake the leather goods to Tal, our wind rider master in ⟦E1⟧, and speak with him to arrange transport to the Crossroads.
rows.quest:6363:completion:0: You need to take this to the Crossroads, eh? That's not a problem. If you've already been there and spoken to Devrak, then you can take one of my wind riders back to him.
rows.quest:6364:obj:0: Buy a wind rider to the Crossroads from the wind rider master Tal, then bring Ahanu's Leather Goods to Jahan Hawkwing.
rows.quest:6364:details:0: In order to fly to a town, you must have already been there and spoken with the wind rider master of that town. You have been to the Crossroads and spoken to their wind rider master Devrak, so for a small fee you can take a wind rider to him from here.
rows.quest:6364:details:1: BSpeak with me again when you are ready. Once at the Crossroads, you can then deliver the leather goods to Jahan Hawkwing.
rows.quest:6364:completion:0: Ahanu sent me finished products? Very good. There are many hunters and adventurers in the Crossroads now and business is lively. I am sure I'll sell these goods very soon.
rows.quest:6364:completion:1: BThank you for all your efforts, ⟦1⟧. I am in your debt.
rows.quest:6365:obj:0: Bring Zargh's Meats to Devrak in the Crossroads.
rows.quest:6365:details:0: I have some choice cuts of meat that I want to send to a friend. Her name is Gryshka, the innkeeper in ⟦E2⟧. Will you deliver the meat for me?
rows.quest:6365:details:1: BThe fastest way to ⟦E2⟧ is on a wind rider. Take the meats to the Crossroads wind rider master, Devrak, and speak with him about transport to ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:6365:completion:0: You have to get this meat to ⟦E2⟧? That is no problem. For a small fee, my wind rider can take you there.
rows.quest:6382:obj:0: Speak with Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:6382:details:0: Your strength impresses me, ⟦2⟧. Your willingness to embrace the hunt gives me confidence that you could move on to bigger game... and bigger challenges.
rows.quest:6382:details:1: BThe forests of ⟦E3⟧ represent a vast untamed wild that the ⟦E4⟧ seeks to impose its own will upon, both politically and spiritually. If you seek to prove yourself in an unproven land, seek the guidance of Senani Thunderheart in Splintertree Post. The outpost is due north of the path leading from the ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:6382:completion:0: Welcome to the new frontier, ⟦3⟧. ⟦E3⟧ is a land of opportunity, one where a young ⟦4⟧ like yourself is able to find boundless chances to prove their mettle. Look around the outpost here, and be sure to travel out to the Zoram Strand, as the ⟦E4⟧ has another outpost there as well.
rows.quest:6382:completion:1: BYour presence here tells me that you've come to learn more about the hunt. Listen close, and I will gladly share with you what you need to know.
rows.quest:6384:obj:0: Buy a wind rider to ⟦E2⟧ from the wind rider master Devrak, then bring Zargh's Meats to Gryshka in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:6384:details:0: For just a few coins I will have a wind rider bring you to ⟦E2⟧. When you get there, you can take Zargh's Meats to Gryshka. Her inn is in the Valley of Strength, not far from the Skytower, where my wind rider will drop you off.
rows.quest:6384:details:1: BSpeak with me again when you are ready for the journey.
rows.quest:6384:completion:0: Oh, wonderful! Those are fine cuts! These are from Zargh, are they? That orc sure knows his way into a lady's heart...
rows.quest:6384:completion:1: BOh, I can't wait to cook it. But not too much! Meat is best served rare, don't you think?
rows.quest:6385:obj:0: Bring Gryshka's Letter to Doras in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:6385:details:0: I've written a letter of thanks to Zargh. Will you deliver it for me? If you've already been to the Crossroads and spoken with their wind rider master, then you can fly a wind rider back there.
rows.quest:6385:details:1: BTake my letter to Doras, the wind rider master of ⟦E2⟧, and speak with him about transport to the Crossroads.
rows.quest:6385:completion:0: You have to get this to the Crossroads in the ⟦E5⟧? Yes, I can get you there...
rows.quest:6386:obj:0: Buy a wind rider to the Crossroads from the wind rider master Doras, then bring Gryshka's Letter to Zargh at the Crossroads.
rows.quest:6386:details:0: My wind riders are trained to fly to many different places, as long as you have already been to that place and spoken with the wind rider master there.
rows.quest:6386:details:1: BYou have been to the Crossroads and spoken to their wind rider master Devrak, so now you can fly directly to him from here. Once you're at the Crossroads, you can deliver Gryshka's letter to Zargh.
rows.quest:6386:details:2: BSpeak with me when you are ready to go.
rows.quest:6386:completion:0: Hah! I guess she liked it! Nothing brings red to a lady's cheeks like a big, juicy steak!
rows.quest:6386:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦5⟧. You've done me a great service. Here is some money for your trouble, and don't be surprised if I invite you to my wedding!
rows.quest:6541:obj:0: Report to Kadrak at the watch tower in northern ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:6541:details:0: Have you ever been to ⟦E3⟧, to the north? The horde has recently set up an outpost on the Zoram Strand there, and we can always use some new recruits to help defend our new fronts.
rows.quest:6541:details:1: BIf you think you are up to it, see Kadrak in the northern ⟦E5⟧, at the watch tower. He is heading up the ⟦E3⟧ campaign and can give you further orders.
rows.quest:6541:completion:0: ⟦E3⟧ is a divided land, but our most recent efforts have been very successful. We not only have an outpost at the Zoram Strand, but another just north of here called Splintertree.
rows.quest:6543:obj:0: Open the Bundle of Reports. Take the Warsong Reports to the Warsong Scout, Warsong Runner, and Warsong Outrider. Bring back the updates they give you to Kadrak at the northern watch tower in the barrens.
rows.quest:6543:details:0: I recently deployed a few scouts into ⟦E3⟧ and I need a runner to take them their orders, and bring me back a report of what they have observed.
rows.quest:6543:details:1: BYour first stop should be the Zoram'gar Outpost, along the coast to the west, at the Zoram Strand, to locate the first runner. You also need to stop at Splintertree Post, to the north, and along the road to the east, near ⟦E6⟧. You will find a scout and an outrider there.
rows.quest:6543:details:2: BGive them each a report, and from them, get an update on their findings.
rows.quest:6543:completion:0: I can see that you are one that can be counted on. These updates are crucial to our plans to further our presence in ⟦E3⟧. We can now plan our next move.
